anchors.text:
Keep only narrowly justified metadata needed to prevent duplicate charging
   or resurrection; fields and retention must still be explicitly finalized.

anchors.section: Remaining decision and contract gates first bullet
anchors.text:
Exact backup/PITR retention window, restore procedure, and numeric lifetime
  and minimal field set for dedup, invalidation and deletion metadata.

Remove deleted/expired content from active stores, including replay copies,
   within 24 hours of deletion/expiry.

policyConclusion: Existing approval requires bounded anti-charge/resurrection metadata but explicitly reserves exact fields/lifetimes/backup handling.
Legacy USER control120day dedup/7day mutation receipt/PITR7day and separate account-deletion120day do not approve governed marker purposes by analogy.
Governed candidate only7day original settlement projections excludes mutation/recognition. No inherited authority for new account-lifetime controls, mutation receipts or erasure markers.
No new persistent mutation fields/storage/wiring are fully policy-determined now. Contract/fixtures remain authorized; recognition G1/G2 independent and held.
conditionalTechnicalRecommendations: Versioned original expected incarnation+generation must be bound to destructive request intent. After a7day operation receipt expires, UUID-only request cannot distinguish late replay from new use; no infinite sameUUID/conflict guarantee after deleting memory.

One atomic admission transaction captures current History incarnation/generation with receipt. Settlement transaction must fence same current control, settle accounting once, and suppress BOTH governedHistory and resultSummary for pre-clear admissions.
Clear read exclusion must cover governed GET, reconcile, consumer replay and caches immediately; physical purge<=24h is separate. Snapshot enumeration is not clear linearization.

Same-operation unknown commit resolves only by exact original-operation readback, no new operation or provider retry. Generation/inventory/profile/deletion/device/source conditions all belong to same transaction.
Missing or rolled-back control cannot silently initialize generation0 or revive old incarnation. Randomness is not evidence of legitimate retirement or nonrollback restoration.

Finite691680s control horizon is a CANDIDATE, conditional on enforced<=480s History-producing lease+original604800sHistory+86400spurge. Current generic Settings has positive lease validation, not a universal480s cap.

Only genuinely new admission or first mutation commit may extend appropriate control hold; read/retry/reconcile must not renew. Preserve each original result deadline and operation first-commit deadline.
Control retirement requires verified complete retained-key inventory, canonical original-deadline/unfinished-job proof and acknowledged physical cleanup; wallclock or DynamoDB TTL alone is not proof.

Without retained retirement witness, fresh random incarnation is privacy-safe only by suppressing ALL old/missing-incarnation sources, proofs, summaries and caches. Explicit StartFresh/destructive invalidation is a NEW customer behavior to approve; otherwise absence remains failclosed.

Nonpersonal global restore incarnation must actually be authoritative outside rollback set. Restoring controls+receipts together cannot prove erasures. Backup/PITR window and nonrollback/discard/quarantine alternative remain separate explicit choices.

minimumOwnerChoiceNotApproval.scope: New purpose-separated governed controls only; do not reopen badges/pricing/reporting/previous milestones.
minimumOwnerChoiceNotApproval.candidateExistingReceipt: Erasure flag on existing receipt only until its ORIGINAL7day deadline; no new per-result TTL.
minimumOwnerChoiceNotApproval.candidateOperationReceipt: Content-free owner/op/intent+terminal response metadata for7days from first commit, no replay renewal; target-derived HMAC still linked data and may outlive original result.
minimumOwnerChoiceNotApproval.candidateFiniteControl: Explicit numeric691680s activity horizon with enforced lease and purge proof, not account-lifetime exception; control expiration/retirement and missing-control failclosed semantics must be fixed.
minimumOwnerChoiceNotApproval.candidateAbsenceRecovery: Explicit StartFresh replacement incarnation invalidates all old History instead of implying recovered continuity; needs approval, not silent bootstrap.
minimumOwnerChoiceNotApproval.backupRestore: Approve exact bounded backup/PITR window plus enforceable nonrollback restoration or explicit discard alternative. No approved numeric governed backup bound identified.

notClaimed: No final doc or implementation review yet for this new contract.
No owner approval inferred, no new code/store/field/metadata retention, no services/auth/runtime/device/tracker/publication action.
